h1: Spreadsheet outputs that land where your team works
overview: Data that stays in a file nobody opens does not help. We take your processed results and send them to the places your team already uses, such as Google Sheets, Excel, Airtable, a SQL database or your CRM. We set up the column layout, formats and update rules, so new rows arrive in the right place without anyone copying and pasting.

faq: Which tools can you send data to?
Google Sheets, Excel online, Airtable, Notion databases, common SQL databases and many CRMs. If your tool has a connection we can use, we will confirm it before you order.
Will it overwrite my existing data?
Not unless you want it to. We agree whether new data is added, merged or updated, and we test on a copy first so your live sheet is never the experiment.
Can the same result go to two places?
Yes. The Standard package covers two destinations and Premium four, for example a sheet for the team and a database for reporting.
What if a value does not fit a column?
It is saved to an errors tab with the reason, so nothing is lost and a person can correct it. The rest of the batch continues normally.
